text: Coming from Habitica and TickTick, I had a hard time finding a tool that could even remotely compete. This is it. It takes a little bit of setup, but it's extremely customizable with about every feature one can want. Task dependencies? Check. Gamification and rewards? Check. Habit tracking? Yup, even both ways (should / should not). Web support for organizing tasks on a bigger screen? Yessiree. This is the swiss army knife of task tracking and self-management tools. It's great.

This app is the perfect accompaniment, especially for weekly check-ins, adding tasks on the fly, and knocking over offline tasks. It's uncluttered and easy to use.

text: Tried half a dozen, this is the only task organisation app that has ever worked for me. Used it daily for half a year now. Essentially you can turn major features on and off and force the app to work for you, unlike other tools that force you to conform to their ideas of how to manage your tasks/productivity. I also like how easily I can use it for both personal and work purposes, and combine them to one list if I want.
